causes.what: Visually authoritative original PDF prints the second action's 1/32. Poppler text extraction separates stacked numerator/denominator and an adjacent regex /1\s*32/ is not an accurate literal math oracle. Exact source PDF SHA256 and original block SHA256 succeeded.
causes.fix: Retain original signed 1/32 semantic in source packet and SSC and guard against its mutation; use page-image visual reading plus exact immutable original source byte/hash, not fabricated contiguous token. Keep source-layout textual operator/epsilon checks.

causes.what: Replacing /1\s*32/ in the actual source text did not modify the bytes and was not a real hostile.
causes.fix: Replace with a mutation of the independently verified original epsilon symbol/operator that actually occurs, reject no-op edits.
